summary: Full backend + frontend E2E for Publisher (Yayınevi) & Sponsored Content feature. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass (flag status, teacher/parent authorization, publisher CRUD with balance, default-vs-manual amounts, 400 on missing default, XOR student/publisher validation, publisher payment updating balance, snapshot immutability on fee change, teacher own-sponsored visibility, teacher-balance includes sponsor_earnings). Frontend E2E (admin + teacher) confirms Yayınevleri page, add/edit publisher dialog, contacts, add-share flow with default reels amount deducting -5000 ₺ from balance, teacher sponsor fields on teacher edit form, payment-publisher-select present in Ödeme Girişi dialog, teacher dashboard Sponsorlu İçerik card, teacher-menu-sponsor, /teacher/sponsor detail page (total earning ₺8.100,00, Ekim 2026 default month filter, 7 shares), balance-sponsor-card clicks through to /teacher/sponsor.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on publisher-dialog, share-dialog and payment dialog. Non-blocking but worth fixing by adding DialogDescription.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to publisher/share/payment dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings.

(Optional) The /api/teacher/sponsored-contents endpoint returns an object {details,month,record_count,teacher_id,...} while /api/publishers/{id}/sponsored-contents returns a list. Minor inconsistency; consider unifying or documenting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >11600 lines - should be split into feature modules (publishers.py, payments.py, teacher_balance.py).

Sponsored-content endpoints use await check_sponsor_enabled() consistently - good. Snapshot of publisher_name/publisher_amount/teacher_amount at creation is correctly preserved on fee updates (verified).
AdminPublishers.jsx & TeacherSponsorDetail.jsx look clean with proper data-testid coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created test publishers prefixed TEST_PUB_/TEST_NOFEE_/E2E_PUB_ with sample sponsored content & one 7000 ₺ publisher payment during tests. Did not clean up (idempotent test naming).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend sponsor/publisher endpoints fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_sponsor_publisher.py (18 tests, all pass). Frontend flows verified end-to-end incl. menu visibility, admin CRUD, teacher dashboard+menu+sponsor detail+balance integration. Server clock ~Ekim/Oct 2026; teacher sponsor-detail defaults to current month filter.
rca of the issue: No bugs found - feature is functioning per PRD.
